en: A black and white photograph showing a wide, cobblestone street lined with multi-story, traditional European buildings featuring steeply pitched roofs and dormer windows. Mature trees line the left side of the street, while several people, including children, can be seen on the sidewalks to the right. The architecture includes prominent gables and stucco facades. Some shop signs are visible, but the text is unclear.
